documents.text: Customers may return unused items in original packaging within 30 days of delivery. The return label is included in every parcel.
Customers may exchange items for a different size or color within 30 days of delivery at no extra cost.
Standard shipping takes 5 to 7 business days. Express shipping takes 2 business days and costs 12 dollars.
A refund is issued to the original payment method within 10 business days after the returned item passes inspection.
Each order may apply one coupon code at checkout and coupons cannot be combined.
The seasonal discount applies a discount to every order and this discount cannot combine with any other discount.
Payments accept credit cards debit cards and wallet balance. Cash on delivery is not supported.
Every product includes a one year warranty that covers manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is not covered.
The trail shoe runs small; choose one size up from your usual size. Available sizes range from 36 to 46.
The jacket shell uses recycled nylon and the lining uses polyester fleece for warmth.
